title: BIOmarkers of Dyspnea IN Emergency Room
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the capacity of some novels biomarkers Procalcitonin (PCT), Midregional Proadrenomedullin (MR pro ADM), Midregional pro-atrial natriuretic peptide (MR pro ANP), Copeptin (CT pro arginine vasopressin), Pro endothelin to stratify the risk in severe dyspnea.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* tachypnea \> 25 /min or Pa02 \< 70 mmHg or SpO2 \< 93%
* diagnosis suspected: CAP, PE,EACOPD, AHF

Exclusion Criteria:

* other cause of dyspnea,
* unreachable on Day 30
study_population: Severe acute SOB Suspicion of CAP, Acute Heart failure, AE COPD or PE
